reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000652 (the melody read from 000652a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 1 note off in 22); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. John Bernard Wilkes's dates are uncertain, so the page says only that they lived in the 19th century; they died by 1928 (https://hymnary.org/person/Wilkes_John (John B. Wilkes, 1785-1869); https://www.praise.org.uk/?p=29310 (the Baptist Hymn Book Companion gives the arranger of MONKLAND a death in 1882; the Historical Companion to Hymns A&M is unsure he was the John Bernard Wilkes born at Leominster in 1823, organist of Llandaff 1861-65). Whichever he was, he arranged MONKLAND in 1861 and died by 1928: the latest candidate was born in 1823, and the pre-1850 rule's 105 years puts his death before 1929.). CCEH's page gives only the year 1861. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000652a.nwc).
